bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or small nonclear clutches, wristlets or fanny packs up to 6 × 9 inches are permitted after search; diaper bags are inspected at the south-side accessible entrance.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking is included with the ticket; Premier and VIP options are sold separately. Parking lots open about one hour before doors.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The operator’s visitor and arrival pages do not publish an official rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are available inside; guests may bring food in a clear one-gallon bag and one empty bottle or factory-sealed water bottle up to one gallon.
allowed: Factory-sealed water bottle up to one gallon
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is first come, first served without a premium parking pass; accessible seating can be booked online. Guest Services is by the middle ticket gates.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The amphitheater’s official visitor guide does not state a general concert re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The visitor guide does not publish a general Will Call pickup procedure for concerts.

gates.summary: All bags are subject to search at the ticket gates. Guest Services is in the middle of the ticket gates; consult the show listing for gate times.
